metadata.author: Demoiselle Pixel
metadata.description: Load publishes from and publish AI images and 3D models to Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid), using the sign-in saved by the desktop app. Publishes load in the sg_pipeline Toolkit config's Maya, Substance Painter, Mari, Katana and Nuke loaders.

ShotGrid.title: ShotGrid
ShotGrid.description: Load from and publish to Flow Production Tracking.

metadata.description: Finds a publish (newest by type and name, or by id) and outputs its image, file path and publish id.
Saves an image as PNG and publishes it as a Texture (UDIM 1001), Image or Rendered Image.
Converts a 3D model (GLB, glTF, USDZ, FBX, OBJ) to USD and publishes it as USD Geometry.
